security_spec.violation_condition: QEMU TCG translator decodes vmmacc.vv/vwmmacc.vv/vqwmmacc.vv without checking the vm bit, or fails to reject vm=0 for vmmacc.vv (reserved) while incorrectly routing vm=0 for vwmmacc.vv/vqwmmacc.vv to integer-accumulate instead of the FP-accumulate vfwimmacc.vv/vfqwimmacc.vv path, or fails to validate that the required subextension (e.g., Zvvfmmmxi8h) is present before executing the microscaling variant
security_spec.summary: vm=0 repurposes vwmmacc/vqwmmacc opcodes to FP-accumulate MX instructions; missing vm-bit gating in TCG decode causes guest-controlled instruction misrouting, potentially generating incorrect host code from integer-register data interpreted as FP
